experience.title: Senior Machine Learning & Data Engineer
bullets: Own full-stack and AI platform capabilities across Microsoft's internal data and model estate, spanning Federated Data Access (reaching data where it already sits), the Model Passport (which data produced which model), the Answer Evaluation Service (scoring models and generated answers), and Release Review (the gate a group has to clear).
Consolidated Federated Data Access so a product group reads one copy of the data across databases and clouds, carrying the Model Passport record instead of a per-project extract nobody can trace.

Extended the Answer Evaluation Service for machine-learning and generative work alike, measuring a trained model against its own baseline and measuring whether a generated answer was genuinely supported by the documents behind it.

Instrumented Release Review so a group sees what shipped, what it answered and which Responsible AI Standard and ISO 27001 gate it cleared, and an investigation starts from one record rather than from logs nobody kept.

experience.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
bullets: Developed the in-line quality models at Stryker, reading inspection and process data so a drifting production line showed itself before it turned out implants that would fail final inspection.

Clustered free-text device complaints and field-service reports so quality engineering saw a recurring failure mode as one problem rather than two hundred unrelated tickets.

Consolidated manufacturing, quality, service and clinical-registry sources into a single traceable data estate, which in a validated device environment is the precondition for using any of it in a model.
Produced the validation packages quality, regulatory and manufacturing engineering required, setting out what each model measured and the point at which a person had to decide instead.
